title: Hide the unused Fracture row
description: The host sends the seven Fracture tiles (Thunder's Edge) in every game's map_tiles and the board drew them in a row under the galaxy, with four planets nobody can use unless the table plays Thunder's Edge. The client now draws them only once the Fracture is in play (state.fracture_in_play) or the engine already holds the system. The Wormhole Nexus row is unchanged. Synthetic fixtures, not captured engine states.
